'''Cosian wood''' was fibrous tissue harvested from the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cosia/Legends|Cosia]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], a native of the same world, fashioned the [[Hilt/Legends|handle]] of [[Tera Sinube's sabercane|his lightsaber]], as well as the [[cane]] where he kept it, from Cosian [[Wood/Legends|wood]].
